note: Rehearsal length; a full film is 60 to 90 s. Scene times live in T in index.html; set them from the voice track cue times (or the picture, for a silent film). Length lives in data-duration (stage and the sfx audio).
theme: theme.json holds the palette, glows, canvas and motif. It is derived from the post's subject: profile-wrap new-gif <slug> --style console-stage --theme-from <logo-or-screenshot>. theme.css is generated from it.
vfx: fx.js: ripple, burst, bubbles, pulse, shine, shake, count, sparkles, drain (seeded, on the paused timeline)
sfx: sfx/*.wav computed in code by sfx/make_sfx.py; the composition logs cues in window.__probe.sfx and profile-wrap mixes assets/sfx-mix.wav

narration.captions: off until real cues exist; never caption unspoken text
